description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Compare two to four postcodes for English council and market data. One credit if any property resolves. If none resolves, no charge: no_data_available for permanent misses or upstream_unavailable if a lookup needs retrying. To check one postcode, use check_address, which is free.

household.description: single: one household; small_hmo: 3-4 people from 2+ households; large_hmo: 5+ people from 2+ households

postcodes.description: Full postcodes of the rented properties, at most 16 characters each, e.g. ["SE15 5BA", "SW6 1HS"]

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

name: compare_addresses
title: Compare rental addresses
